name: Nacon S.A.
summary: Nacon S.A. designs and distributes gaming accessories in France and internationally. The company offers accessories, including headsets, microphones, controllers, racing wheels, gaming chairs, keyboards, mice, mats, audio accessories, and console accessories. It also develops and publishes video games in various categories, such as action-adventure, racing, sport, and simulation. The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Fretin, France. Nacon S.A. is a subsidiary of BigBen Interactive SA.
